svg.title: PvZ Fusion, French team — A team trained and led
svg.desc: Translate a game. Grow a team. PvZ Fusion never stops changing: fifteen versions in fourteen months. When I joined, the French translation was several versions behind. Ten months later, with the team I recruited and trained, not a single entry was missing.
